,info.FUNCTIONAL_CURRENCY FUNCTIONAL_CURRENCY ,IF(info.CASH_MANA_CATE = '01',position.PROD_TERMS,null) TERMDAY ,case when info.CASH_MANA_CATE = '01' then case when position.PROD_TERMS <= 1 then '01' when position.PROD_TERMS <= 7 then '02' when position.PROD_TERMS <= 30 then '03' when position.PROD_TERMS <= 90 then '04' when position.PROD_TERMS <= 184 then '05' when position.PROD_TERMS <= 366 then '06' when position.PROD_TERMS <= 1096 then '08' else '09' end when info.CASH_MANA_CATE = '02' or info.CASH_MANA_CATE is null then info.TERMTYPE else null end as TERMTYPE2 ,info.IS_TRANSFER IS_TRANSFER ,info.IS_FULLY_COMPLIANT IS_NOTICE ,case when info.PRODTYPE = 'M' then case when info.VDATE = #{enddate, jdbcType=DATE} and info.MDATE != #{enddate, jdbcType=DATE} then (ifnull(val4.TDY_UNIT_VALUE_SUM, 1) - ifnull(val2.TDY_UNIT_VALUE_SUM, 1)) / (ifnull(val2.TDY_UNIT_VALUE_SUM, 1) * (TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY,#{startdate, jdbcType=DATE},info.MDATE) + 1)) * (case when info.BASIC = 'A/360' then 360 when info.BASIC = 'A/365' then 365 else 1 end) when info.VDATE = #{startdate,jdbcType=DATE} and info.MDATE = #{enddate, jdbcType=DATE} then (ifnull(val.TDY_UNIT_VALUE_SUM, 1) - ifnull(val2.TDY_UNIT_VALUE_SUM, 1)) / (ifnull(val2.TDY_UNIT_VALUE_SUM, 1) * (TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY,#{startdate, jdbcType=DATE},#{enddate, jdbcType=DATE}) + 1)) * (case when info.BASIC = 'A/360' then 360 when info.BASIC = 'A/365' then 365 else 1 end) else (ifnull(val.TDY_UNIT_VALUE_SUM, 1) - ifnull(val5.TDY_UNIT_VALUE_SUM, 1)) / (ifnull(val5.TDY_UNIT_VALUE_SUM, 1) * (TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY,info.VDATE,#{enddate, jdbcType=DATE}) + 1)) * (case when info.BASIC = 'A/360' then 360 when info.BASIC = 'A/365' then 365 else 1 end) end when info.PRODTYPE = 'N' then case when info.VDATE = #{enddate, jdbcType=DATE} and info.MDATE != #{enddate, jdbcType=DATE} then (ifnull(val4.UNIT_VALUE_TOTAL, 1) - left join pd on info.prod_id=pd.prod_id where info.FPROD_ID is null and info.vdate <= #{enddate,jdbcType=DATE} /**历史到期产品不统计*/ AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM chb_prd_deal d WHERE d.trade_type = '16' AND IFNULL(d.fprod_id, d.prod_id) = info.prod_id and D.status in ('E','M') AND D.SETTDATE_DATE < #{startdate,jdbcType=DATE} ) and info.status in ('E','M') and info.ISSUING_STATUS in ('01') ) ,rate as( SELECT BASIS_CYY ccyOriginal, QUOT_CYY ccyConvert, TRADE_DATE publishDate, case when #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '02' then CLOSE_PRICE/(case when info.QUOT_UNIT=0 then 1 else info.QUOT_UNIT end) when #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '01' then OPEN_PRICE/(case when info.QUOT_UNIT=0 then 1 else info.QUOT_UNIT end) when #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '03' then HIGH_PRICE/(case when info.QUOT_UNIT=0 then 1 else info.QUOT_UNIT end) when #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '04' then LOW_PRICE/(case when info.QUOT_UNIT=0 then 1 else info.QUOT_UNIT end) when #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '05' then MID_PRICE/(case when info.QUOT_UNIT=0 then 1 else info.QUOT_UNIT end) end yeid FROM MST_EXCHARGE_QUOTE info where info.QUOT_CYY = 'CNY' AND INFO.DATASOURCE_TYPE = 'SAFE' and info.TRADE_DATE = (select max(t.TRADE_DATE) from MST_EXCHARGE_QUOTE t where t.BASIS_CYY = info.BASIS_CYY and t.QUOT_CYY = info.QUOT_CYY and t.DATASOURCE_TYPE = 'SAFE'
and t.OPEN_PRICE is not null

and t.HIGH_PRICE is not null
and t.LOW_PRICE is not null
and t.MID_PRICE is not null
and t.TRADE_DATE <=#{enddate,jdbcType=DATE}) ) /*交易明细表，将产品交易表进行拆分成：本金交易，利息交易*/ ,dd as ( select IFNULL(d.fprod_id,d.prod_id) prodid ,i.prodtype ,d.TRADE_ID ,d.ISSUE_PARTY_ID ,m.objfield1 ord_identified ,d.BUY_PLACE ,d.TRADE_TYPE ,d.SETTDATE_DATE ,d.PAY_DATE paydate ,d.TRADE_PRINCE amount ,d.UNIT_BONUS_AMOUNT ,d.REDEMPTION_FEE ,d.TRADE_QTY tradeQty ,IFNULL(d.ccy,'CNY') ccy ,d.STATUS ,d.ORG_CODE ,d.DEPT_CODE ,d.DATA_SOURCE from chb_prd_deal d
